player.gd:366 'error' SOLVED (5d88ce6-era): it was never a crash - the WARN 'Fx: scale 0.45 requested while already at 0.05' carries a full stack trace that reads like an error. Chain: _land_punch:573 take_hit -> _die -> slow_mo while the same punch's hitstop held time_scale at 0.05. Reproduced 16x in a clean stress run. Fixed structurally by selective hitstop (below): hitstop no longer touches Engine.time_scale, and two colliding slow-mos now MERGE (lower scale, longer end) instead of warning.

Batch 1 selective hitstop: Fx.hit_stop(frames, who) pauses ONLY attacker+target AnimationPlayers and gates their _physics_process via Fx.is_frozen(); eased 4-frame recovery (speed_scale 0.3->1.0 tween); rain/particles/music/crowds never pause. Enemy strikes that clip the hero now hitstop both (3 frames) - they never did before. All 8 player hitstop call sites migrated (jab/cross/heavy/counter/launcher/finisher/kick/super/env takedown/knee/combo multi-hits).
